newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Argentine said sold 8.5-8.6 mln T 1996/97 wheat.
newsitem.headline: Argentine said sold 8.5-8.6 mln T 1996/97 wheat.

text.p: Argentine exporters have sold a total 8.5 million to 8.6 million tonnes of 1996/97 wheat, including 2.4 million tonnes to Brazil, a market source said Tuesday.
The source told Reuters that this would leave 1.5 million to 2.0 million tonnes of 1996/97 bread wheat left to sell for export.
Brazil had bought over three million tonnes by the same period last year, but this season Argentina has taken advantage of a much bigger harvest to sell to new destinations, the source said.

He added that maize export sales have totaled about 5.5 million tonnes so far, out of likely total sales of around 10 million tonnes. Sales so far are about two million tonnes more than at the same point last season.

South Korea has bought about 1.4 million tonnes, Indonesia about 350,000 tonnes, Malaysia 300,000 tonnes, Japan around 190,000 tonnes, and Thailand about 100,000 tonnes, the source said. He added that Iran has taken 700,000 tonnes and Venezuela 350,000-400,000 tonnes.
